learnedFrom.title: Something’s Happening to the Ozone Hole

adjustedAfterLooking.why: The measured 22.87 cuts/min is b-roll and graphics, not host framing: the host is recognisable in only 14 of 89 overview tiles, and of the 24 checked detections (cuts-01/02, 0:00.7-0:34.9) 21 are real picture changes and none is a host framing change (1 host to b-roll at 0:00.709, 13 b-roll to b-roll, 7 animation/archival/graphic), 3 are false (grainy VHS archive at 0:32.7, 0:33.3, 0:34.7). So the A-roll should not chase 22.87: it holds one framing up to maxHoldSec 4 s (60 / 4 = 15 framing changes a minute) and the b-roll layer supplies the rest. targetCutsPerMinFirst60 stays 28: the one host run in the hook (first60 tiles 0:37-0:41, real about 0:37.5-0:43) shows three framings in about 5 s. edit.punchIn.scale is confirmed, not changed (recorded 1.12 -> 1.12 so a re-run knows it was checked): the studio base framing is locked (the wall print lines up within 0.3 px on the cut-sheet 0:00.709 tile and the 6:58 and 14:18 overview tiles) and the other three studio tiles (2:12, 6:25, 7:42) are 1.10-1.16x bigger and shifted toward the face, i.e. about 1.1x punch-ins on about half the studio shots. Overview tile labels on these sheets are about 11 s early (pre-fix learn.mjs); cut-sheet times are exact.
